label: Kaldor VX-88 Kestrel (Remnant)
note: Issue #76: the Remnant's own interceptor, painted dark: the same airframe and guns as the port's (interceptor.json). One sits beside each desert outpost (flyable: taking it sets off that outpost's alarm and scrambles the barracks interceptor), and one dark interceptor stands on the barracks pad and hunts you in the air (src/systems/flight/atmo_fighter.gd). 'scramble' (interceptor only) is how that one behaves.

dogfight_foe.note: Only as an enemy in a space fight (Dogfight.spawn_ship merges this over the ship, block by block): slower, slower to turn, a thinner shield and a worse pilot than the same airframe you fly, so the escort and the skirmish can be won. Stolen and flown by you, or hunting you over the port, it is the ship above.

scramble.note: launch_distance: metres from the town's edge you must be before it takes off after you (a stolen outpost ship scrambles it at once). floor_agl / look_ahead_s: it pulls up when it is lower than this above the ground now or look_ahead_s ahead. ceiling_margin: it never climbs closer than this to the edge of space. give_up_s: seconds with nothing to chase (you landed, went to space, or are not wanted) before it flies home. respawn_s: shot down (in the air or on its pad), a new one stands on the pad this long after. replace_s: taken from its pad (it is flyable there, and taking it sounds the barracks alarm), a new one lands this long after, once nothing is within pad_clear metres of the pad, and comes after you. land_from: metres from the pad where it comes straight down; return_altitude: how high it flies home.
